description: common/mod.rs parse_rfc5322_headers is a custom minimal parser used by MemoryBackend for import_email and parse_email. It diverges from the jmap-mime crate's proper MIME parsing in at least these ways: (1) raw_headers construction uses .lines() which splits on LF only, losing CRLF continuation fidelity; (2) preview is first 256 chars of raw body text, not a MIME-decoded text/plain part; (3) no Content-Type parsing, so all bodies are treated as opaque text. Integration tests run against this parser, not against jmap-mime. If there is a bug in jmap-mime's conversion but not in the home-grown parser, the tests will pass. A contributor who writes new tests using import_email is testing a different code path from production.
title: parse_rfc5322_headers in test backend is home-grown and not used in production path
